subject: Film & Cinema
title: Satire and Dark Comedy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Satire and Dark Comedy.

hook.text: Dr. Strangelove made nuclear annihilation funny. That was the point.

buildup.text: Satire uses humor to expose absurdity in politics, society, and human behavior.

discovery.text: Dark comedies work because laughter is how humans process uncomfortable truths.

twist.text: The best satires age well because the absurdities they mock keep repeating.

climax.text: From Network to Don't Look Up, satire holds a mirror society would rather avoid.

punchline.text: The joke is always on us.

quiz.question: What makes satire different from regular comedy?
options: It's always set in the past
It uses humor to critique society and politics
